package.description: An IDE designed for agentic AI research.

en-US.description: An IDE designed for agentic AI research.
en-US.longDescription: AgentsDock is an open-source IDE for agentic AI research that unifies Claude Code, Codex, and other coding agents in a single workspace across desktop and mobile. It connects to multiple servers such as lab workstations and GPU boxes, offers code viewing and editing with syntax highlighting, persistent tmux terminal access, and inline viewing of agent outputs like plots, images, and rollout videos.
en-US.name: AgentsDock

zh-CN.description: 一款为 AI 智能体研究设计的 IDE。
zh-CN.longDescription: AgentsDock 是一款面向 AI 智能体研究的开源 IDE，将 Claude Code、Codex 等编码智能体统一到跨桌面与移动端的同一工作区中。它可以连接实验室工作站、GPU 服务器等多台设备，提供带语法高亮的代码查看与编辑、持久的 tmux 终端访问，以及对图表、图像和回放视频等智能体输出的内联查看。
